name: Grand Parade Investments Limited
source: Grand Parade Investments Limited consolidated audited annual financial statements for the year ended 30 June 2025 (https://www.grandparade.co.za/investor-centre/results-reports-notices), consolidated statement of profit or loss page 15, printed in R thousand: Revenue 292 (2025) and 1 437 (2024), from note 8.2 disaggregation (dividends received 124, board fees 168); profit for the year 61 201 (2025) and 73 647 (2024). Ties inside the filing: profit before taxation 59 919 less the taxation credit of 1 049 equals 60 968 from continuing operations, plus 233 from discontinued operations equals 61 201; prior year 77 226 less 1 476 equals 78 702 plus a loss of 5 055 equals 73 647. The earlier cells were withheld by the profit-above-revenue guard, which is correct for a trading company and wrong for an investment holding company whose only revenue is dividends and board fees, so both cells are restored from the audited statement. Printed basic earnings per share 14.32 cents (2025) and 17.14 cents (2024) agree with the EPS row already stored. CRON 2026-11-11: Revenue and Net Profit for FY2025 and FY2024 restored from the audited summarised results for the year ended 30 June 2025 (SENS short form announcement, 23 September 2025; figures in R thousand): Revenue 292 (2025) and 1 437 (2024); profit for the year 61 201 (2025) and 73 647 (2024), being continuing operations 60 968 plus discontinued operations 233 for 2025 and 78 702 less 5 055 for 2024. Basic earnings per share 14.32 cents (2025) and 17.14 cents (2024) agree with the EPS row already stored. Both cells had been withheld by the profit-above-revenue guard, which is correct for a trading company but wrong for an investment holding company whose only revenue line is dividends received and board fees; the guard is now exempted for this file and period. Net Margin stays blank because profit over that revenue line is not a margin.
